body.statement:
For every \(0<h\le r_0\), every \(1\le k\le m h^d\) satisfying \(m h^d\ge C_S^2\log(8/\eta)\), and every \(J_\pi,J_\mu\ge1\), the released set \(C_n(h,k)\) is replacement \((\epsilon_n,\delta_n)\)-differentially private and satisfies
\[
 \inf_{Q\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{att}}}
 \Pr_Q\{\tau_Q^{\mathrm c}(x_0)\in C_n(h,k)\}\ge1-\eta.
\]
Coverage probability integrates the sampling law, all pilot and moment Gaussian noises, and the deterministic sample split.

obligation.what_is_open: Complete unconditional honest coverage after the uniform-remainder inequality is established for the corrected learner.
obligation.obstruction: Privacy is proved in this bundle and the deterministic identification-to-coverage implication is complete, but the target's probability lower bound still depends on the unresolved uniform-remainder lemma.  Using that conclusion before proving it would assume the only remaining statistical crux.
obligation.attempted: I made admissibility explicit, proved the privacy input, and carried the coverage event through pointwise causal identification and truncation of the interval.
obligation.partial_result:
Assuming the still-unproved probability inequality in \(\mathrm{lem{:}uniform\text{-}remainder}\), let
\[
 E_Q=\left\{\left|\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{DP}}(x_0;h,k)-\tau_Q(x_0)\right|
 \le R_n(h,k)\right\}.
\]
Then \(\Pr_Q(E_Q)\ge1-\eta\).  By \(\mathrm{lem{:}pointwise\text{-}identification}\), \(\tau_Q(x_0)=\tau_Q^{\mathrm c}(x_0)\); by \(\mathrm{ass{:}bounded\text{-}outcomes}\), this common value lies in \([-1,1]\).  Hence \(E_Q\) implies \(\tau_Q^{\mathrm c}(x_0)\in C_n(h,k)\), even after intersection with \([-1,1]\).  Taking probabilities and then the infimum over \(Q\in\mathcal P_{\mathrm{att}}\) gives the advertised coverage.  Privacy is already established by \(\mathrm{lem{:}private\text{-}release\text{-}and\text{-}sensitivity}\).  This completes the deterministic reduction, but it cannot establish unconditional coverage until the uniform-remainder target is proved.

body.justification: The headline converts a fully privatized higher-order CATE learner into an honest pointwise causal interval.
body.gap: SchroederHartensteinFeuerriegel2025 proves a private interval for the regular population ATE, while no located theorem gives uniform pointwise Hölder CATE coverage with higher-order nuisance bias.
body.consumer: A hospital can release a confidence interval for the treatment effect at a prespecified clinical profile while protecting every patient record.
